title: Miami Events This Week: Sept 28 to Oct 3
igCaption:
Free first: Bingo After Dark is Monday in Dania Beach with RSVP.
Other picks include Buena Vista Social Club at the Arsht, two Fillmore shows, Karol G's Casadonna dinner, and her two-day pop-up.
Save this for plans this week.

Sources: Miami New Times, Secret Miami

#MiamiEvents #SouthFloridaEvents #MiamiThingsToDo #MiamiThisWeek

scenes.text: Miami event picks this week start with a free one.
Monday, September twenty-eighth: Bingo After Dark: Uncensored starts at seven p.m. at Ft. Lauderdale Improv in Dania Beach. Oronde Gadsden and Efendee Studio host, and admission is free with RSVP.
scenes.caption: Monday, Sept. 28: Bingo After Dark: Uncensored is at 7 p.m. at Ft. Lauderdale Improv in Dania Beach. Oronde Gadsden and Efendee Studio host the adult-humor bingo night, and admission is free with RSVP.

scenes.text: Tuesday, September twenty-ninth: Buena Vista Social Club opens at the Adrienne Arsht Center at seven-thirty p.m. as part of Broadway in Miami. The Tony- and Grammy-winning musical follows Omara Portuondo. Tickets cost fifty-two to two hundred twenty-eight dollars.
scenes.caption: Tuesday, Sept. 29: Buena Vista Social Club opens at the Adrienne Arsht Center at 7:30 p.m. as part of the Broadway in Miami series. The Tony- and Grammy-winning musical follows Omara Portuondo, and tickets cost $52 to $228.

scenes.text: Wednesday, September thirtieth: Of Monsters and Men play the Fillmore Miami Beach at eight p.m., with tickets at fifty-eight fifty. Thursday, Diego Torres brings his Mi Norte & Mi Sur Tour there, with tickets from fifty-two to eighty-six dollars.
scenes.caption: Wednesday, Sept. 30: Of Monsters and Men play the Fillmore Miami Beach at 8 p.m. Tickets cost $58.50. Thursday, Diego Torres brings his Mi Norte & Mi Sur Tour there. Tickets cost $52 to $86.

scenes.text: Thursday, October first: Karol G's Medellín restaurant Carolina brings Territorios to Casadonna at seventeen thirty-seven North Bayshore Drive. Chef Emilio Valencia leads the menu with Chef Lisbeth Mora and Casadonna's team. Dinner costs one hundred fifty dollars per person.
scenes.caption: Thursday, Oct. 1: Karol G's Medellín restaurant Carolina brings Territorios to Casadonna at 1737 N. Bayshore Drive. Chef Emilio Valencia leads the menu with Chef Lisbeth Mora and Casadonna's team. Seatings run from 6 p.m. to 10 p.m., and dinner costs $150 per person.

scenes.text: Friday and Saturday, October second and third: Karol G's Viajando Por El Mundo pop-up runs from eleven a.m. to six p.m. at five fifty-five Northwest Twenty-ninth Street. It includes interactive stops, custom stamps, exclusive merch, and first-come, first-served entry.
scenes.caption: Friday and Saturday, Oct. 2 and 3: Karol G's Viajando Por El Mundo pop-up runs from 11 a.m. to 6 p.m. at 555 NW 29th Street. It includes interactive stops, custom stamps, exclusive merchandise, and first-come, first-served entry.
